Hinge Breaker.name: Hinge Breaker
Hinge Breaker.description: The user braces, charges for one turn and fires at a jammed door or gate within ten meters, breaking its hinges for heavy bludgeoning damage. The user checks that the far side is clear before firing; held back, the shot only bends a lock. Reinforced vault doors resist it, and the hot barrel cannot fire until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: heavy.
